description: The recurring kinds of problem found in a project (the Problems page), biggest first, each with its id, severity, how many problems it holds, whether it is marked solved, and the start of its suggested fix. Use it for "what keeps going wrong" and "what should we fix first". A category's fix is written for all of its problems at once, so prefer it over fixing problems one by one; get_problem_category gives it in full. Filter by mode (regular, red_team, bias) or source (test, live) to list only the categories holding such problems, counting only those.

mode.description: Only problems found by tests of this mode: regular, red_team or bias. Live traffic counts as regular.
mode.title: Mode

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: test for Test Lab runs, live for the agent's real traffic.
source.title: Source
